name: Start Access policy test
description: Start Access policy test Starts an Access policy test. POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/policy-tests
context:
POST /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/policy-tests
Starts an Access policy test.
Required: account_id (path); body (body)

name: Get an Access policy test users page
description: Get an Access policy test users page Fetches a single page of user results from an Access policy test. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/policy-tests/{policy_test_id}/users
context:
GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/policy-tests/{policy_test_id}/users
Fetches a single page of user results from an Access policy test.
Required: account_id (path); policy_test_id (path)
Optional: page (query); per_page (query); status (query) — Filter users by their policy evaluation status.

name: Get the current status of a given Access policy test
description: Get the current status of a given Access policy test Fetches the current status of a given Access policy test. GET /client/v4/accounts/{account_id}/access/policy-tests/{policy_test_id}
